method.priceRule: production network's 1,024-block median base fee + 1,024-block median tip (50th reward percentile) at the table's reading; Arbitrum One pays no tip
method.l1Rule: Arbitrum One: NodeInterface.gasEstimateL1Component (L2 gas units) x the table's price; OP Mainnet: GasPriceOracle.getL1Fee (wei); both from the -table read-backs made right after the reading
method.rateRule: Coinbase spot ETH-USD and AVAX-USD at the table's reading
method.gasRule: Ethereum: the local later cycle (confirmed on Hoodi); the others: the later-cycle mean of the receipts on the test network
method.roundingRule: two significant digits in USD below 1 USD, two decimals above; full precision in this file

rows.measuredOn: Hoodi (gas of the local measurement, confirmed call by call on Hoodi)

gas.source: benchmarking/results/local-gas-final-2026-10-12.md (later cycles, mean of cycles 2 to 10; confirmed call by call on Hoodi, hoodi-final-2026-10-13.md)
